question: As of April 07, 2025, what is the total value of MSCI's operating leases (in $'s, thousands) that are maturing in the next three years? What percentage?
model_answer:
Need the FY2024 10-K table; fetch.Using MSCI's FY2024 10-K (balance date December 31, 2024), its operating leases maturing over the next three years (2025–2027) total **about $85,002 thousand (≈ $85.0 million)**. That is **about 51.3%** of total undiscounted lease payments.

I used the 10-K for fiscal year 2024, which is the latest annual filing as of April 7, 2025. I treated "next three years" as 2025, 2026 and 2027.

| Year | Operating lease payments ($ thousands) |
|---|---|
| 2025 | 30,220 |
| 2026 | 30,361 |
| 2027 | 24,421 |
| **Total, 2025–2027** | **85,002** |

Total undiscounted lease payments are $165,605 thousand, so $85,002 ÷ $165,605 ≈ 51.3%.

The percentage is measured against undiscounted payments, before the $19,601 thousand of interest. The present value of the lease liabilities is $146,004 thousand.

Source: [MSCI Inc. Form 10-K, FY2024](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1408198/000140819825000053/msci-20241231.htm)
judge_reason: Model gives $85,002 thousand and 51.3%, both matching the official answer exactly.
